working_geometry_plain: The working Phase 2 geometry is PEPS3D-anchored finite response-quotient carrier geometry. After S_loss_residue_class_separation_K, the earned object is a finite three-class loss-residue quotient with three class-pair separations over PEPS3D V/E/F/C loss vectors. All three scalar L1 gaps are equal, so the next bounded question is whether the coordinate support masks of those separations remain finite, PEPS3D-anchored, and noncollapsed. This is not topology, closure, Hopf/Weyl, terrain, substages, flux, Xi/Phi0, Axis0, physics, or game theory.

candidate_maps_considered.why_admissible: It ratchets directly from S by refining the equal scalar class-pair gaps into finite PEPS3D V/E/F/C coordinate support masks. It preserves the real limitation that F is null in the current pair deltas and cannot claim full V/E/F/C closure.

candidate_maps_considered.why_rejected: Section/retraction language risks topology, sheaf, restoration, or inverse claims. S only earns finite class-pair separation.
All-subset minimality is stronger closure work and is not earned by class-pair separation.
The quotient and separation rows do not support restoration, invertibility, or same-object recovery.
Finite coordinate-support masks are not topology, persistence, sheaf, gluing, or closure evidence.
The DD pair-delete interaction candidate is already killed because pair-order gaps collapsed to zero.
Norm-only is saturated and non-informative because all three class-pair L1 gaps equal 2.
Full V/E/F/C coordinate coverage is not earned because the F coordinate is zero in all current pair deltas.
Hopf/Weyl, terrain, substages, flux, Xi/Phi0, Axis0, physics, IGT/game theory, and axes 7-12 are downstream and remain blocked.
